description.invocation: One offline batch-32 full inference forward under torch.inference_mode(): FP32 pretrained microsoft/resnet-18 (local assets, dtype=torch.float32, .cuda().eval()) executes model(pixel_values=pixels).logits on the GPU-resident 32x3x224x224 float32 input built once as images[torch.arange(32) % 3].contiguous() from pixels.npy, producing the complete 32x1000 FP32 logits tensor. Model loading, input staging/transfer, reference construction, correctness checks, warmup, statistical repeats and report writing are benchmark infrastructure outside this unit.
notes: Measured invocation is one infer(model, pixels) call (resnet_inference.py:15-16,30) for the offline row; harness timing brackets it with torch.cuda.synchronize + perf_counter_ns (resnet_inference.py:42-47).

User goal selects the offline batch-32 row from workloads.json resnet_inference.workloads and requests full inference latency; objective latency_ms is the source's per-sample key (resnet_inference.py:48) with median-of-5 summary (common.py:66-71 summarize). images_per_second = batch * 1e9 / elapsed is its exact reciprocal, per README not an independent goal; peak_allocated_bytes stays a recorded non-objective metric.

Constraint conversion: the source memory goal's notation images_per_second_min_baseline_ratio 0.95 (workloads.json resnet_inference offline) is expressed generically as images_per_second >= 0.95 x baseline; meaning unchanged (throughput floor on the same batch-32 workload).

Discrete exact output: require_exact_top1 means argmax(-1) predicted class indices must equal the reference exactly (resnet_inference.py:33 torch.equal on argmax); the full 1000-class FP32 logits are compared with atol=rtol=1e-4 via torch.testing.assert_close (common.py:74-76), and a +1-corruption negative control must be rejected (common.py:79-84).

Numerical policies preserved: dtype=torch.float32, local_files_only=True, inference_mode, TF32 disabled for matmul and cudnn, cudnn.benchmark=False, float32_matmul_precision 'highest', torch.manual_seed(20261020), 4 CPU threads, interop 1 (common.py:34-42 configure; resnet_inference.py:23).

Input is real image data: pixels.npy holds 3 preprocessed public images (float32 NCHW 224, ImageNet mean/std, prepared offline per prepare_resnet_assets.py and asset-manifest.json); batch 32 selects images[arange(32) % 3].contiguous() on GPU (resnet_inference.py:29); host-to-device transfer and preprocessing are outside timing (README measurement section).

Model is pinned microsoft/resnet-18 revision 65a5785d9156231087c481e0c7dd33a5ff6f7e3e (asset-manifest.json); runner needs only transformers, torch, numpy - no Pillow/torchvision at runtime (prepare_resnet_assets.py docstring). The .jpg assets are provenance only.

Command provenance: user command 'python resnet_inference.py --assets /root/autodl-tmp/dev/v6-work/validation-assets/resnet18 --output /tmp/original-resnet' runs the full harness over all configured workloads with defaults --workloads workloads.json, warmup 2, repeats 5, no --profile; the offline row is the selected workload and the diagnostic torch.profiler run (common.py:87-105) was not requested.

Single process on one CUDA device (common.py:34 configure sets device 0; deployment leases GPU-6c11763a-1e00-9af3-e17d-274f5d7f78ba); device_count=1 although the machine inventory lists two RTX 4090s. No distributed backend and no communication collector fields required; torch_communication metrics are not requested for this workload.

Reference construction (double infer + close_check + negative_check + exact top1 + saving {id}-reference.pt) and result.json writing (resnet_inference.py:30-37,54) belong to measurement infrastructure, not the repeated unit.

assumptions: The evaluator's objective metric key for full inference latency is the source's per-sample key latency_ms (ms, lower is better); no rank aggregation or distributed aggregation order applies to this single-process workload.

Default --workloads (repo workloads.json), warmup=2 and repeats=5 apply because the user command does not override them; only the offline batch-32 row is selected from the two configured resnet_inference workloads.

peak_allocated_bytes and the exact-reciprocal images_per_second remain recorded metrics of the same row; the only performance constraint carried into the objective is the source's 0.95 throughput floor.
device_count=1 reflects the workload's actual requirement (one leased GPU in deployment.devices), not the two-GPU machine inventory.
